messages:
marie: Heads up — canary rollout for v1.14.2 is hitting OOMs on longctx instances. Saw 6 failures in the last hour. :eyes:

juan: Where exactly? logs?

marie: eng-runtime/canary-us-west-2, mostly seqlen > 4096 workloads. stack traces show mmap failure in kv_arena_alloc. sample log:
```
2026-11-03T15:22:10Z ERROR OOM kv_arena_alloc: requested 262144 bytes, available 0
pid=... model=redwood-13b seq_len=8192
```

tara: interesting — we merged pr#8734 yesterday (alloc alignment + faster slab packing). suspected tradeoff: tighter packing but different alignment causing fragmentation.

kevin: CI perf job started flagging memory regression on macroscopic test suite — mem_peak +18% on longctx profile. cc @ci-bot

ci-bot: perf/regressions: memory_peak increased by 18% in job runtime/longctx/bench — build 20261103-8734 vs 20261102-8729

juan: can we bisect to the exact commit? I can run git bisect on the canary image.

marie: please do. also add --run-longctx when running the stress harness.

juan: running bisect now. quick note: reproducer is heavy but deterministic on our harness.

(20m later)

juan: bisect points to commit 9b3f2d4 (PR 8734) — allocation alignment change. repro script attached:
```
./harness --profile longctx --seed 42 --model redwood-13b --seq 8192
```

tara: ok rollback PR8734? can we do a targeted revert for the alignment change and leave packing improvements?

kevin: packing logic intertwined. safer to revert the whole PR from canary, push hotfix and re-run canary. marking rollout-blocker.

marie: deploying revert (revert PR 8751) to canary in 2m. @deploy-bot please run canary-deploy with new image tag redwood-runtime:20261103-hotfix

deploy-bot: started canary-deploy redwood-runtime:20261103-hotfix to eng-runtime-canary

sre-oncall: watching logs. adding alert silence for noise.

(5m)

deploy-bot: canary health OK after revert, no new OOMs in 10m window. metrics: mem_peak normalized.

kevin: CI confirmed — perf job now shows memory_peak delta +1% vs baseline. ci-bot: re-run full perf.

ci-bot: re-run queued: perf/full-suite on build 20261103-hotfix

juan: follow-up: we need unit/regression test that reproduces fragmentation pattern for seqlen>4096. adding a longctx allocation stress test to eng-runtime tests.

tara: opened issue #1127 for allocation API refactor and to decouple alignment logic. tagging eng-runtime and eng-runtime/alloc

marie: action items: 1) revert merged (done) 2) add regression test (juan) 3) design a microbenchmark for slab fragmentation (tara) 4) plan rework of PR8734 to separate concerns (kevin)

kevin: also schedule perf-run during next CI gate and add threshold alert for mem_peak>+10% on longctx.

juan: I'll push the test this afternoon and attach heap profiles. snippet of jemalloc stats showing fragmentation (before revert):
```
allocated: 2.1G
active:    2.8G
fragmentation: 33%
```

marie: thanks everyone. publishing postmortem draft later today. closing until we see any recurrence. :thumbsup:
